articles.title: Yolanda Galloway, 85, Tailor
articles.deck: Friends remember Yolanda Galloway for the many years of service to Marsh Landing.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Marsh Landing.

Born in Marsh Landing in the years after the war, Yolanda Galloway spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center in his or her name.
Yolanda Galloway died in June at home on Dayton Road, at the age of 85.

articles.title: Letter: Support the Winter Coat Drive
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the winter coat drive in the budget. Many of us on Cooper Drive use it every week.
Harold Lindqvist, Kettle Hill

body: Councilmember Owen Kellerman asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $12,000. Residents of Hickory Ridge said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.
